propositions: fetcher._iter_pages terminates on a short page instead of an empty page, advancing by requested page_size rather than actual len(page), causing 92% of issues to be silently lost from the inbound snapshot when Jira truncates results below the requested size
a server that silently truncates maxResults to enforce jira.search.views.default.max causes the pager to read a short first page as the final page and stop iteration prematurely
collect() feeds _build_snapshot with a truncated issue list, so unseen issues are candidates for deletion and unseen unbound issues fail to reconcile while the pass reports success
when a server ignores startAt and returns the same non-empty page indefinitely, the pager loops forever instead of raising SilentTruncationError to prevent offset stall
the fix must advance by len(page) and terminate only on empty page, with an offset-stall guard that distinguishes repeated full pages (raises) from repeated short pages (stops cleanly)
